parameters.query:
SELECT s.queryid::text AS queryid, s.calls, s.rows, r.rolname AS usuario,
       left(s.query, 200) AS consulta
FROM pg_stat_statements s
JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = s.userid
WHERE s.rows > 1000
  AND s.query ~* '\m(clientes|ventas)\M'
  AND s.query NOT ILIKE 'COPY %'
  AND r.rolname <> 'backup_db'
  AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_statements%'
ORDER BY s.rows DESC
LIMIT 5;
